source.author: verg
source.text: Non, mihi si linguae centum sint oraque centum, ferrea vox, omnis scelerum comprendere formas, omnia poenarum percurrere nomina possim.
source.text_original: Non, mihi si linguae centum sint oraque centum, / ferrea vox, omnis scelerum comprendere formas, / omnia poenarum percurrere nomina possim.'
source.text_english: No, even if I had a hundred tongues, a hundred mouths, and a voice of iron, I could not comprehend all the forms of crimes, nor run through all the names of punishments.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: non, mihi si linguae centum sint oraque centum, ferrea uox, omnes captorum dicere poenas, omnia caesorum percurrere nomina possim.
reuse.text_original: non, mihi si linguae centum sint oraque centum, ferrea uox, omnes captorum dicere poenas, omnia caesorum percurrere nomina possim.
reuse.text_english: No, if I had a hundred tongues and a hundred mouths, a voice of iron, I could not tell all the punishments of the captives, nor run through all the names of the slain.
